text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe finally sets her sights on debuting in the Twinkle Series. Her goal is a little on the strange side.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She dreams of overtaking her friend, an entity she's been chasing since childhood, who only she can see.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Agnes Tachyon is preparing for her own debut in the Twinkle Series. A peer of Manhattan Cafe's, her talents are already considered impressive.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Agnes Tachyon has high expectations of her, Manhattan Cafe is focused exclusively on her own goal—pursuing her friend.
